from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, zipfile
root=Path('checkpoints')
archives=sorted(root.glob('*.zip'))
assert archives, 'no checkpoint archives'
for archive in archives:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
        assert z.testzip() is None, archive
        manifest={}
        for name in z.namelist():
            if name.endswith('/CHECKPOINT_MANIFEST.json'):
                import json
                manifest=json.loads(z.read(name))
                break
        assert manifest, archive
        for rel,digest in manifest.items():
            assert hashlib.sha256(z.read('react-fastapi-base/'+rel)).hexdigest()==digest, (archive,rel)
    sidecar=archive.with_suffix('.zip.sha256').read_text().split()[0]
    actual=hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert sidecar==actual, archive
    print(archive.name, 'PASS', actual)
PY
